dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, light-gray perimeters against a dark-gray background. The transitions are sharpest at the outer edges of the annuli, with internal regions of the 'O' shapes showing a slight return to the base dark-gray intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-density concentration of small, bright-white pixel clusters is observed along the upper dorsal ridge and the cephalic region. These clusters appear as scattered, point-like intensities rather than gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent annuli on the lateral mid-section form an elongated obtuse triangle oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, interconnected chain of three annuli creates a distinct 'linked-ring' topology on the lower posterior lateral surface.
